sloka: किमर्थं मामनादृत्य क्लिश्यते ऽयं त्वया जनः ।निवर्तयैनमुद्योगं जनो ऽयं स्वजनो मम ।। ६.११७.२५ ।।
transliteration: kimarthaṁ māmanādṛtya kliśyate 'yaṁ tvayā janaḥ ।nivartayainamudyogaṁ jano 'yaṁ svajano mama ।। 6.117.25 ।।

translations.english: Exhibiting anger with his gaze at the uproar, Rama addressed the highly intelligent Vibheeshana resenting their action.
